title: 第9章 勾栏听曲暮时归
content_zh:
第9章勾栏听曲暮时归
咕噜咕噜——
车轮碾过青砖，在裴府门外停下。
裴湘君抱着毛茸茸的鸟鸟，犹如等待夫君归来的良家贵妇，站在灯笼下眺望。
眼见夜惊堂从马车下来，裴湘君露出笑意：
“惊堂，事情谈得如何？杨冠没为难你吧？”
“三娘，你怎么在门口等着。”
夜惊堂踏上台阶，抬手摸了下比他会享受的鸟鸟：
“没为难。费了好多口舌，才和杨员外把事情讲清楚……”
“咳咳——”
正在卸马车的陈彪和两个不熟悉的镖师，闻言都是一个趔趄，回头看向夜惊堂，意思估摸是：
你前后加起来说了五句话，管这叫费尽口舌？
杨冠是没为难你，原因你自己不清楚吗？
老跟班杨朝和六子等人，倒是反应平淡。
毕竟在他们看来，少东家今天确实费尽口舌。
换在无法无天的边关小镇，遇上这种泼皮，少东家说一句话都嫌多，砍完扭头就走了。
夜惊堂没搭理几人的眼神，继续温和解释事情的过程，以免裴三娘一个妇道人家，被吓到。
裴湘君从头到尾都跟在后面看着，自然不会受惊，她如同乖巧小妇人，听夜惊堂说完话后，轻咬下唇眼神崇拜：
“真厉害，家里有个男人就是不一样~”
绝色佳人露出崇拜强者的眼神，杀伤力很大。

夜惊堂自认不重名利，但在三娘崇拜的小眼神儿下，还是觉得有点飘，很大男子气概的摆手：
“举手之劳罢了。”
“刚才我和你大伯母商量好了，让你当裴家的少东家，月俸给你开百两银子，你不嫌少吧？”
少东家，约莫就是裴氏集团副董事，权限足够开银库；月薪百两纹银，换算下就是月薪十来万。
这待遇有些夸张，夜惊堂要是接了肯定亏心，摇头道：
“三娘说了男人该自食其力，转头又给我这待遇，街上的掌柜准不服气。就按照镖局镖头的薪水开吧。”
陈彪听见这话，连忙摇头：“夜少爷，你还真见外，你今天把杨冠摆平，省下的银子可不止这点儿。再者镖头一个月十二两银子，放在您身上能干啥？裴少爷出去喝顿酒，都不止这个钱……”
裴湘君也点头道：“是啊。当少东家可不潇洒，出门应酬的场合多的很，要是和文德桥的官宦子弟喝酒听曲儿，你打赏姑娘都摸不出钱，岂不坠了裴家门面？这银子纯当零花钱，你真不好意思，用心帮家里做事就行了。”
夜惊堂见此，也就不再推让：
“那就听三娘的安排。青莲庄的事情完了，家里可还有其他事情要我去办？”
裴湘君的事情挺多——大哥死于江湖，‘枪魁’名号被夺，这仇没报；不少江湖势力抢财路，没人出头平事儿；红花楼几大堂主不安分，不停施压让她让位。
但这些都是江湖事，夜惊堂接触还过早，就含笑道：
“手下一堆掌柜，岂能事事都让东家出面。今天下雨，也没啥交际应酬，你先歇着吧，让陈彪带着你在京城转转。”
说着裴湘君凑近几分，取出一张银票，悄悄塞到夜惊堂怀里：
“以后都是你手下人，没事带他们出去下馆子喝个小酒，也是少当家的分内事。”
陈彪听见这话，来了精神，麻溜就把马送回了马房。
鸟鸟听到下馆子，瞬间觉得裴湘君怀里不软和了，跳到了夜惊堂肩膀上，对着裴湘君挥翅膀：“叽叽叽~”估摸在说——大奶姐姐再见……
夜惊堂先进屋换回了常服，才带着几个镖师出发。
不过将要走的时候，裴湘君瞧见陈彪笑容贼兮兮，又提醒了一句：
“陈彪，你别乱带地方。惊堂刚从外面过来，没见识过京城的花花世道，你要是把惊堂带成裴洛那样……”

陈彪贼兮兮的笑容一收，故作老成：
“当家的，你看我老陈像那号人吗？”
“三娘放心，我自有分寸。”
夜惊堂回了一句后，就带着几个手下离开了巷子。
半个时辰后，春香阁二楼。
抱着琵琶的乐师，在台上唱着婉转小调。
三个彩衣舞女，随歌起舞，身段婀娜。
七八个龙精虎猛的镖师，瞪大眼睛从窗口望着楼下的姑娘，直咽唾沫，连菜都不舍得夹一口。
夜惊堂在包厢里就坐，推杯换盏，鸟鸟则在旁边摇头晃脑，感觉比夜惊堂喝的还多。
陈彪双手端着酒杯，敬了夜惊堂一下：
“少东家，您还真是有分寸！”
夜惊堂奉命带手下出来‘团建’，自然不可能太寒酸：
“听个曲罢了，又不是去窑子。边关的姑娘，说实话比京城差太多，八成比我都壮，要不是我会点武艺，十四岁就被抢去拜了堂……”
陈彪眨了眨眼睛，凑近道：
“少东家，您不会还是……”
夜惊堂不太好回答这个问题。
旁边醉醺醺的杨朝，接话道：
“瞧你这眼力劲儿，以少东家的相貌，出去找姑娘，姑娘该倒给钱。这赔本生意，换你你做？”
“也是。和少东家相配的姑娘，在我看来只有文德桥的千金小姐，外面的庸脂俗粉想拱白菜，我第一个不答应……”
“呵呵……”

勾栏听曲，吃吃喝喝。
几人正把酒言欢之际，外面的街道出现了些许喧哗。
踏踏踏——
大队步卒跑动的声音。
几人眉头一皱，起身到窗前查看，却见不少禁军和黑衙的捕头，在雨中奔行，方向是视野尽头的鸣玉楼一带。
“怎么回事？”
“这么大动静，估摸是靖王府那边出了岔子。黑衙里关了不少江湖匪类，鸣玉楼里听说也个把时辰就消停了。”
事不关己，夜惊堂也没有太留意，继续喝起了酒。
武夫酒量都不小，喝的酒又比较上等，香而不烈，大半天硬是没一个人喝倒，时间也不知不觉到了下午。
酒足饭饱后，有个色胚镖师，还言语暗示去‘荤场子’接下一场。
但陈彪知道轻重，听曲儿看看姑娘没啥，敢带少东家去荤场子，三娘铁定把他们全扫地出门，最终没敢和夜惊堂开口，众人就此散去。
等到天色渐黑，夜惊堂再度一人一马一鸟，回到了染坊街。
三娘今天给的银票，算是预支了一个月薪水，百两银子，足够租个两进大院，运气好指不定还能买个能暖床的小丫鬟晚上解闷。
夜惊堂虽然对住处不挑，但也没刻意吃苦的习惯，下了一天雨，屋子破那么大个洞，肯定没法落脚了。
夜惊堂现在回来，是准备收拾屋里的些许物件，和房东太太说一声，换个环境好点的住处。
吱呀——
没挂锁的老旧院门
夜惊堂把马拴在厨房的屋檐下，收起伞来到主屋，推门而入，还在和鸟鸟说着话：
“以后老实点，别没事往女人怀里钻……”
鸟鸟一副没听见的样子，蹲在肩膀上哼叽：

“叽叽叽~……”
但下一刻，人和鸟都是一静。
屋子家徒四壁，本就没多少东西，有什么变化自然一眼就能看出来——屋顶的破洞，被一件蓑衣遮了起来。
但夜惊堂和鸟鸟，并未注意到这些，只是茫然盯着床铺。
铺着深灰床单的双人床下方，整齐放着一双绣有竹叶的青色绣鞋。一个陌生女人，在床榻上盘坐，头梳妇人髻，斜插着一根碧玉珠钗，看起来是个年轻少妇。
少妇皮肤极为白皙，生得一双漂亮的桃花眼，双眉犹如二月初春的柳叶，樱桃小口未点胭脂，却天生红润饱满，面容用国色天香来形容都显得俗套，更像是来到农舍报恩的狐仙、或者嫁入牛郎家里的仙女，硬是美出了几分出尘于世的仙味儿。
少妇身上裹着淡青色的披风，只能看到白皙双手收于腹部，掐子午诀，姿态如世外高人，应该在运转某种高深功法，额头挂着些许香汗，可见丝丝缕缕水雾从发髻间冒起，就和发高烧快熟了一般。
“叽？”
鸟鸟站在夜惊堂脚边，歪头望向床底，似乎在找下面的蒸锅。
夜惊堂莫名其妙，连少妇出尘于世的姿色都没注意，只怀疑自己是不是走错门了。
但屋顶破这么大个洞的房子，京城估计找不到第二家。
“女侠？”
夜惊堂回家窝被占了，不可能扭头出去，他在门口呼唤了一声，却不见少妇有反应，想了想，就握着刀走向床铺。
鸟鸟则是缩着脑壳，躲在门后探头，一副心惊胆战的模样……
content_en:
Chapter 9 Goulan listens to music and returns at dusk
Gulu gulu——
The wheels ran over the green bricks and stopped outside the door of Pei Mansion.
Pei Xiangjun held the fluffy bird in his arms, like a noble lady waiting for her husband to return, standing under the lantern and looking at it.
Seeing Ye Jingtang getting off the carriage, Pei Xiangjun smiled:
"Jingtang, how did things go? Yang Guan didn't make things difficult for you, right?"
"Sanniang, why are you waiting at the door?"
Ye Jingtang stepped onto the steps and raised his hand to touch the bird that he would enjoy more:
"It's not difficult. It took a lot of talking to explain the matter clearly to Yuan Wai Yang..."
"Ahem——"
Chen Biao and the two unfamiliar bodyguards who were unloading the carriage staggered when they heard this. They turned back to look at the Night Jing Hall. What they probably meant was:
You said five sentences in total. Do you think this is a waste of words?
Yang Guan didn't make things difficult for you. Don't you know why?
The old followers Yang Chao, Liu Zi and others reacted indifferently.
After all, in their opinion, the young master's family really spent a lot of money today.
In a lawless border town, when encountering such a ruffian, the young master would have said too much, turned around and left after beheading him.
Ye Jingtang ignored the looks of several people and continued to explain the matter gently, so as not to scare Pei Sanniang, a womanly woman.
Pei Xiangjun followed from the beginning to the end and watched, so naturally she was not frightened. She was like a well-behaved little woman. After listening to Ye Jingtang's words, she bit her lower lip lightly and looked at her with admiration:
"It's amazing. It's different when there's a man in the house~"
The look of a stunningly beautiful woman worshiping a strong man is very lethal.
Ye Jingtang admits that he doesn't value fame and wealth, but under Sanniang's admiring eyes, he still feels a little bit arrogant, and he waves his hand in a manly manner:
"It's just a little effort."
"I just discussed with your eldest aunt to let you be the young master of the Pei family. I will give you a monthly salary of one hundred taels of silver. Don't you think it's too little?"
The young master is probably the deputy director of the Pei Group, with enough authority to open a bank; his monthly salary is a hundred taels of silver, which translates into a monthly salary of over 100,000 yuan.
This treatment is a bit exaggerated. Ye Jingtang would definitely feel bad if he accepted it. He shook his head and said:
"Sanniang said that men should earn their own living, and then she turned around and gave me this treatment. The shopkeeper on the street will definitely not be convinced. Just pay it according to the salary of the head escort of the escort agency."
When Chen Biao heard this, he quickly shook his head: "Master Ye, you are really out of touch. You settled Yang Guan today and saved more than this amount of money. Besides, what can you do with twelve taels of silver a month as a bodyguard? Master Pei goes out for a drink, and it costs more than this..."
Pei Xiangjun also nodded and said, "Yes. Being a young master is not a cool thing. There are many occasions to go out and socialize. If you drink and listen to music with the officials' children in Wende Bridge, you can't even get the money to reward the girl. Wouldn't you lose the reputation of the Pei family? This money is purely pocket money. You are really embarrassed. Just help the family with your heart."
Seeing this, Ye Jingtang stopped giving in:
"Then I'll listen to Sanniang's arrangements. Now that the matter at Qinglian Village is over, is there anything else at home that I need to do?"
Pei Xiangjun had a lot of things going on - her eldest brother died in the Jianghu, and the title of 'Leader of the Guns' was taken away, but the revenge was not avenged; many Jianghu forces were vying for money, but no one stepped forward to calm things down; several hall leaders in Honghua Tower were restless and kept putting pressure on her to give up her position.
But these are all Jianghu matters, and it was still too early for Ye Jingtang to contact him, so he said with a smile:
"I have a bunch of shopkeepers, how can I let my boss take part in everything? It's raining today, so there won't be much socializing. You should rest first and let Chen Biao take you around the capital."
As he spoke, Pei Xiangjun came closer, took out a banknote, and quietly stuffed it into Ye Jingtang's arms:
"They will all be your subordinates from now on. It is the young master's job to take them out to a restaurant for a drink if they have nothing to do."
When Chen Biao heard this, he became energetic, and Ma Liu sent the horse back to the stable.
When Niaoniao heard about the restaurant, he immediately felt that Pei Xiangjun's embrace was not soft anymore. He jumped on Ye Jingtang's shoulder and waved his wings at Pei Xiangjun: "Chi Chi Chi~" I guess.Said - Goodbye, Big Breasted Sister...
Ye Jingtang went inside first and changed into his regular clothes before setting off with a few escorts.
But when he was about to leave, Pei Xiangjun saw Chen Biao's treacherous smile and reminded him again:
"Chen Biao, don't take the place randomly. Jingtang has just come from outside and has never seen the colorful world of the capital. If you lead Jingtang to be like Pei Luo..."
Chen Biao dropped his thief smile and pretended to be mature:
"Master, do you think I, Old Chen, look like that person?"
"Don't worry, Sanniang, I have my own sense of discretion."
After Ye Jingtang replied, he left the alley with a few of his men.
Half an hour later, on the second floor of Chunxiang Pavilion.
The musician holding the pipa sang a melodious tune on the stage.
Three colorful dancers danced to the song with graceful figures.
Seven or eight vigorous escorts looked at the girl downstairs from the window with wide eyes, swallowing hard and not even willing to take a bite of the food.
Ye Jingtang sat in the box, changing glasses, while Niaoniao was shaking his head next to him. He felt like he drank more than Ye Jingtang did.
Chen Biao held the wine glass with both hands and toasted Ye Jingtang:
"Young master, you are really measured!"
Ye Jingtang was ordered to bring his men out for 'team building', so naturally it couldn't be too shabby:
"It's just to listen to music, not to go to a brothel. To be honest, the girls at the border are much worse than those in the capital. They are probably stronger than me. If I hadn't learned some martial arts, I would have been taken away to worship at the age of fourteen..."
Chen Biao blinked, leaned closer and said:
"Young Master, won't you still..."
Night Terror Hall is not easy to answer this question.
The drunk Yang Chao next to him answered:
"Look at your sharp eyesight. With your young master's appearance, if you go out to find a girl, the girl should give you money. Would you rather do this loss-making business?"
"That's right. In my opinion, the only girl who is suitable for my young master's family is the daughter of Wende Bridge. If the vulgar fans outside want to win over me, I will be the first to refuse..."
"Haha..."
Listen to music, eat and drink.
While several people were drinking and chatting, there was some noise in the street outside.
Tap tap tap——
The sound of large groups of infantry running.
Several people frowned, got up and went to the window to check, only to see many Forbidden Army and Hei Yamen arresters running in the rain, towards the Mingyu Tower area at the end of their field of vision.
"What's going on?"
"With such a big commotion, there is probably something going wrong in Prince Jing's Mansion. Many gangsters were imprisoned in the Black Yamen, and I heard that the gangsters in Mingyu Tower were all calmed down within an hour."
It had nothing to do with him, so Ye Jingtang didn't pay much attention to it and continued to drink.
Wu Fu drank a lot, and the wine he drank was relatively high-quality, fragrant but not strong. For most of the day, no one drank it, and it was afternoon before he knew it.
After we had had enough wine and food, there was a sexy escort who even hinted that we should go to a 'meat shop' to take over the next scene.
But Chen Biao knew the importance. He listened to the music and saw that the girl was okay and dared to take the young master's family to a meat market. Sanniang was determined to kick them all out. In the end, he did not dare to speak to Ye Jingtang, and everyone dispersed.
When it got dark, Ye Jingtang returned to Dyefang Street alone, one horse and one bird.
The banknote Sanniang gave her today was an advance of one month's salary. One hundred taels of silver was enough to rent a house for two to enter the compound. If she was lucky, she might be able to buy a maid who could warm the bed to relieve her boredom at night.
Although Ye Jingtang was not picky about where to live, he was not in the habit of deliberately enduring hardships. It rained all day and there was such a big hole in the house that he would definitely not be able to stay.
Ye Jingtang is back now, intending to pack some things in the house and talk to the landlady about changing to a place with a better environment.
Squeak——
Old courtyard door without padlock
Ye Jingtang tied the horse under the eaves of the kitchen, put away his umbrella and came to the main house, pushed the door open and entered, still talking to Birds and Birds:
"Be more honest from now on and don't get into women's arms..."
Niaoniao looked like he didn't hear anything, squatting on his shoulder and humming:
"Chi chi chi~..."
But the next moment, both people and birds were silent.
The house has four bare walls, there wasn’t much in it, so any changes could be seen at a glance—the hole in the roof was covered up by a raincoat.
But Ye Jingtang and Niao Niao didn't notice this and just stared blankly at the bed.
Under the double bed covered with dark gray sheets, there is a pair of cyan embroidered shoes embroidered with bamboo leaves neatly placed. A strange woman was sitting cross-legged on the bed, with her hair in a woman's bun and a jade hairpin stuck sideways. She looked like a young woman.
The young woman's skin is extremely fair, with a pair of beautiful peach blossom eyes. Her eyebrows are like willow leaves in early February. Her cherry lips are not rouged, but they are naturally rosy and plump. Her face is clichéd even if it is described as beautiful and fragrant. She is more like a fox fairy who comes to the farmhouse to repay her kindness, or a fairy who marries into the Cowherd's family. She is so beautiful that she has the air of a fairy from this world.
The young woman was wrapped in a light cyan cloak, and all she could see was her fair hands gathered on her abdomen, pinching the Ziwu Jue. Her posture was like that of an outsider, who must be performing some advanced martial arts. There was some fragrant sweat hanging on her forehead, and wisps of water mist could be seen rising from her bun, as if she was about to have a high fever.
"Ji?"
Niaoniao stood at the foot of Night Terror Hall, tilting his head and looking at the bottom of the bed, as if he was looking for the steamer below.
The Night Terror Hall was so confused that he didn't even notice the young woman's appearance in this world, and only wondered if he had gone to the wrong door.
But there is probably no other house with such a big hole in the roof in Beijing.
"Heroine?"
Night Terror Hall returned home and the nest was occupied, so it was impossible to turn around and go out. He called out at the door, but saw no response from the young woman. After thinking about it, he walked to the bed with the knife in hand.
Niaoniao, on the other hand, shrank his head and hid his head behind the door, looking frightened...
